Euphoria Season 3 officially premieres on April 12, 2026, on HBO and Max, following a four-year hiatus. The new season is set to jump forward in time, following the group as they navigate the "virtue of faith and the possibility of redemption" outside the halls of East Highland. Legendary composer Hans Zimmer has joined the team for Euphoria Season 3, collaborating with returning series musician Labrinth to score the HBO drama's highly anticipated return. With production officially wrapped and the first teaser posters already dropping, the countdown to the most anticipated return in television history has begun.
